Scope it all out down below.

There are some particularly notable MacBook Pro deals live at B&H right now that are either undercutting Amazon or delivering major price drops on configurations you can’t buy there – we will pull them from the list above for better visibility:

This Titanium Apple Watch Series 11 cell model just hit one of its best prices ever at $169 off

Joining the $100 price drops on the most popular Apple Watch Series 11 models starting from $299, we just spotted a notable and likely fleeting chance to land the Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell with the Natural Titanium Case at $169 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell with the Natural Titanium Case and Stone Gray Sport Band down at $529.97 shipped.

This is a regularly $699 configuration now seeing a solid $169 price drop to deliver one of the lowest prices we have tracked to date.

This model did drop to $515 for Prime Day this year, but it quickly solid out and has been largely unavailable on Amazon since. Previous to that, we had never tracked it for less than $569.

If this deal is anything like the other Cell variants we have tracked with special price drops like this, it is not likely to last for long before it sells out again.

This is certainly a more niche configuration than the base variants, if not for any other reason than it featuring Apple’s premium Titanium case and the cell connectivity (and the higher price tag that comes along with), but this is certainly a solid price drop.

For those more interested in the base models, here’s how pricing shakes out there right now:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Black Friday in July iPhone 17 Pro deals up to $220 off (Amazon Renewed Premium), or 17 Pro Max up to $449 off

We have tracked a number of chances to land refurbished iPhone 17 Pro units this year, but we wanted to highlight Amazon’s top-quality Renewed Premium discounts for Black Friday in July week – you can land iPhone 17 Pro with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee at up to $220 off right now.

Black Friday in July iPhone 17 Pro deals

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)

These listings are shipped and sold directly from Amazon, come along with its 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee, and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Aside from the actual condition of the phone being the best renewed units Amazon carries, this is also the main difference between Amazon “excellent refurbished” units and Renewed Premium – you get a full year of coverage and a proper battery.

Yes, we have seen the excellent refurbs sell for less, but the it comes to landing a deal on a high-quality unit, Amazon’s Renewed Premium continues to be one of, if not, the best option out there.

When it comes to the larger iPhone 17 Pro Max, the ongoing Woot deals are still too good to pass up. These are “PRISTINE and have never been in customer hands” and includes a “test sticker showing 100% battery life and inside a sleek custom black box.” In other words, they are essentially brand new but you don’t get the Apple packaging and they are “NOT AppleCare eligible.” But at up to $449 off, this seems a worthy trade-off for some folks.

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (Reg. $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (Reg. $1,999)

Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 now $100 off for Black Friday in July (All colors)

Alongside the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and the return all-time low on the new AirTag 2, one of the better Black Friday in July deals knocks $100 off the 2026 AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s latest AirPods Max 2 down at $449 shipped, which is a straight up $100 off the $549 list price for the best deal around right now.

This deal is live on all five colors: Midnight, Blue, Orange, Starlight, and Orange.

You’re looking at the lowest price we have tracked on the latest-generation Apple over-ears outside of the short-lived Prime Day price that saw most colors going out of stock before the event even ended. Today’s deal is the only other time we have seen them at better than $50 off since release earlier this year.

Alongside the ongoing summer deal on AirPods Pro 3, this week is ushering in some new Apple deals with return all-time lows on AirTag 2 and a $100 price drop on AirPods Max 2. But we are also tracking one of the best prices to date on brand new unlocked iPhone Air models at $159 off.

As part of the Best Buy Black Friday in July sale, you’ll now find all Apple iPhone Air models at $160 off the list prices:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (Reg. $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (Reg. $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (Reg. $1,400)

Best Buy has largely been the place to score the best deals on iPhone Air since release in fall 2025. Apple’s ultra-thin handset previously maxed out at $149 off in our early June mention, but all models are now $10 less than our previous mention to deliver the best deal we have tracked from a reputable source.

You will find some used and refurbished listings for less at Amazon, but when it comes to brand new unlocked models, Best Buy is where you’ll want to be.

That said, Amazon is offering slightly better prices on other current-generation Apple gear by comparison to the Best Buy Black Friday in July offerings:
